content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

How much of the FY2025 revenue change came from FX versus volume, by company?

content.statement:
WITH __bridge AS (
  SELECT
    company AS br_company,
    fx_effect_inr,
    revenue_2024_inr,
    revenue_2025_inr,
    volume_effect_inr
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_AGENT_BRIDGE
)
SELECT
  br_company AS company,
  SUM(revenue_2024_inr) AS revenue_2024_inr,
  SUM(volume_effect_inr) AS volume_effect_inr,
  SUM(fx_effect_inr) AS fx_effect_inr,
  SUM(revenue_2025_inr) AS revenue_2025_inr
FROM __bridge
GROUP BY
  br_company
ORDER BY
  revenue_2025_inr DESC
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: f65da1bf-51b7-4010-ab7e-43b4b811352c)
;
